children: may retrace into a range of $103.50-$104.51 per barrel, following its failure to break a resistance at $106.26.
The resistance is identified as the 12.6% projection level of a wave c from $97.11. The contract failed both to overcome this barrier and to break a short trendline.
The failure is likely to be followed by either a correction into the target zone or a continuation of the downtrend from $107.29.
A break above $105.59 may lead to a gain into the $106.26-$107.34 range. On the daily chart, a bullish flag pattern looks doubtful, as the market keeps falling towards $102.67.
The pattern will be confirmed only when the contract breaks above $105.88. A break below $102.67 may trigger a fall into the $94.21-$98 range.
